verdict.rationale: Zoho CRM's REST API is clearly versioned: the docs are served under an explicit /api/v8/ path for modules, records, bulk write, notifications, scopes and limits. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines or version-support windows, so only half the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented deprecation/sunset policy, version lifecycle and support-window details, changelog or migration guidance, independent corroboration.
